sources.title: DLD normalized Avida Residences individual residential sales, 10 October export

facts.identityBasis: Unique non-archived Avida Residences catalogue record in Dubai Islands, corroborated by IQUNA's official project page. DLD public status identifies Avida Residences project 4066 in Palm Deira with 50 residential units, legal developer Serene Marina Real Estate Development L.L.C, developer number 2139; the downloadable developer register confirms ID 685297965. DLD's developer contact uses the official iqunaproperties.com business domain. This corroborates the project association without inferring corporate aliases or a subsidiary relationship. Only Residential/Unit/Flat sales with exact project number 4066, area 432 and project/building Avida Residences are included. Advertised prices, planned schedules, dated progress and transaction values remain separate. Generic map coordinates are excluded.

observation.observationDateBasis: DLD instance_date registration day; not first-ever sale, contract execution or current valuation
